summary.effect: You keep a second identity with its own papers, acquaintances, and disguises. You can forge official papers or personal letters if you have seen an example of that document or handwriting.
Needs no prerequisite. +1 CHA. Advantage on Deception and Performance checks when posing as someone else, and you can mimic voices you have heard.
+5 to initiative. You cannot be surprised while conscious, and unseen attackers gain no advantage against you.
+1 STR or DEX. Standing up costs 5 feet of movement, climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps need only 5 feet of run-up.
After you Dash, a bonus-action melee attack deals +5 damage or a shove 10 feet, if you moved 10+ feet in a straight line first.
Ignore the loading property of crossbows, no disadvantage for ranged attacks at 5 feet, and a bonus-action hand crossbow attack after a one-handed attack.

name: Defensive Duelist

summary.effect: Needs DEX 13. Reaction with a finesse weapon: add your proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack.

trigger: A creature hits you with a melee attack while you wield a finesse weapon

summary.effect: +1 AC while wielding two melee weapons, two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons, and drawing or stowing two weapons at once.
Advantage to find secret doors and on saves against traps, resistance to trap damage, and normal travel pace while searching for traps.
+1 CON. When you roll a Hit Die to heal, the minimum you regain is twice your CON modifier.
Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to it, and your 1s on its damage dice count as 2s.
Needs STR 13. Advantage on attacks against a creature you grapple, and you can try to pin it so both of you are restrained.
Heavy melee weapons: take -5 to hit for +10 damage. After a crit or a kill, make a bonus-action melee attack.
With a healer’s kit, use an action to restore 1d6 + 4 + the target’s level in HP. Once per rest for each creature.
Needs medium armor training. +1 STR and heavy armor proficiency.
Needs heavy armor training. +1 STR. While in heavy armor, reduce nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage by 3.
Needs CHA 13. After a 10-minute speech, up to six allies gain temporary HP equal to your level + CHA modifier.
+1 INT. You always know north and the time to the next sunrise or sunset, and you recall anything seen or heard in the past month.
+1 STR or DEX and light armor proficiency.
+1 INT. Learn three languages and create written ciphers that others need a check to read.
Three luck points a long rest. Spend one to roll an extra d20 on your attack, check or save, or against an attack on you, and choose which die counts.

name: Mage Slayer

summary.effect: Reaction attack against an adjacent caster. Advantage on saves against spells from adjacent creatures, and they lose concentration more easily.

trigger: A creature within 5 feet casts a spell

summary.effect: Pick a class. Learn two of its cantrips and one 1st-level spell, and cast that spell once a long rest.
Learn two Battle Master maneuvers and gain one d6 superiority die, restored on a short or long rest.
Needs medium armor training. Medium armor does not impose stealth disadvantage, and the DEX bonus to AC can reach +3.
+10 ft. speed. After you Dash, difficult terrain costs no extra movement, and creatures you attack in melee cannot make opportunity attacks against you that turn.
Needs light armor training. +1 STR or DEX, plus medium armor and shield proficiency.
Advantage against unmounted smaller creatures while mounted. You can redirect attacks aimed at your mount, and it takes no damage on a successful DEX save.
+1 INT or WIS. Read lips, and add +5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation.
Bonus-action butt-end attack with a polearm, and opportunity attacks when a creature enters your reach.
Pick an ability. +1 to it and proficiency in its saving throws.
Needs INT or WIS 13. Keep a ritual book and cast ritual spells from it, adding more you find.
Once per turn, roll a melee weapon’s damage dice twice and use either result.

name: Sentinel

summary.effect: Opportunity attacks stop the target’s movement, trigger even on Disengage, and you can strike when an ally within 5 feet is attacked.

trigger: A creature you can see within 5 feet attacks someone else

summary.effect: Ranged weapons: no disadvantage at long range, ignore half and three-quarters cover, or take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
Bonus-action shove with a shield, add its AC bonus to DEX saves against single-target effects, and take no damage on a successful save that halves it.
Gain proficiency in any three skills or tools of your choice.
Needs DEX 13. Hide while lightly obscured, missing a ranged attack does not reveal you, and dim light does not impose perception disadvantage.
Doubled range for attack-roll spells, ignore half and three-quarters cover on them, and learn one attack cantrip.
+1 STR or CON. Proficient with improvised weapons, d4 unarmed strikes, and a bonus-action grapple after hitting with one.
Your hit point maximum rises by 2 for every level you have, now and at each new level.
Needs the ability to cast a spell. Advantage on concentration saves, casting with hands full, and a spell as an opportunity attack.
+1 STR or DEX and proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
Gain one extra skill proficiency from the barbarian skill list. While raging you may use STR for some checks of those skills.
When you start a rage, you can move up to half your speed as part of the same bonus action.
Learn two spells of your choice from any class. They count as bard spells.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may also swap one expertise skill for another, or one bard cantrip for another.
Bonus action: spend a Channel Divinity use to regain one expended spell slot, up to half your proficiency bonus in level.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap one cleric cantrip for another.
Spend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar without a component cost. The familiar lasts hours equal to half your druid level.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap one druid cantrip for another.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap a fighting style or a maneuver you know for another.
If you spend ki on your action, you can make one unarmed or monk weapon attack as a bonus action before the end of that turn.
Action: spend 2 ki to heal yourself for a martial arts die plus your proficiency bonus.
After missing with a monk attack, spend 1 to 3 ki to add +2 to the roll for each ki point spent.
Bonus action: spend a Channel Divinity use to regain one expended spell slot, up to half your proficiency bonus in level.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap a fighting style for another.
Gain expertise in one skill and learn two languages. Bonus movement speeds and temporary HP arrive at higher levels.
When you hit a creature, mark it (needs concentration). Once per turn it takes extra damage that grows with level. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Cast a few nature spells, such as speak with animals, once per long rest without a slot as you level.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap a fighting style for another.
Bonus action: gain advantage on your next attack roll this turn, but your speed drops to 0 until the end of the turn. You cannot use it if you moved.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap one sorcerer cantrip, or one Metamagic option, for another.
When an ability check fails, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll the d20 and keep the new result.
When you gain an Ability Score Improvement you may swap a cantrip, an Invocation, or a Mystic Arcanum spell.
When you finish a long rest you may swap one wizard cantrip you know for another from the wizard list.
Fighter, paladin or ranger. You sense creatures within 10 feet that are not fully hidden from you, even without sight.

name: Fighting Style: Interception

summary.effect: Fighter, paladin or ranger. Reaction: when an ally within 5 feet is hit, reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your proficiency bonus.

trigger: An ally within 5 feet is hit by an attack

summary.effect: Fighter, paladin or ranger. Learn one Battle Master maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die, restored on a short or long rest.
Fighter, paladin or ranger. Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack, and add +2 to its damage.
Fighter, paladin or ranger. Unarmed strikes deal d6 (d8 with both hands empty), and you deal 1d4 to a creature you grapple.
Paladin. Learn two cleric cantrips that count as paladin spells; swap one when you gain a level.
Ranger. Learn two druid cantrips that count as ranger spells; swap one when you gain a level.
Touch a tiny nonmagical object to give it a minor effect for as long as you hold it: light, a recorded message, a smell or sound, or a visual. Number of objects equals your INT modifier.
INT-based caster. Needs thieves tools or an artisan tool in hand as a focus. You prepare spells each long rest and can cast prepared rituals.
After a long rest, imbue up to your infusion limit of nonmagical items with infusions you know. Each item holds one infusion and works for one attuned creature. You learn more infusions as you level.

name: The Right Tool for the Job

summary.effect: With thieves tools or an artisan tool, spend an hour to make a set of artisan tools in an empty space within 5 feet. They last until you use this again.
Raise one ability by 2, or two abilities by 1, or take a feat.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using a tool you are proficient with.

name: Flash of Genius

summary.effect: Reaction: when you or a creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or saving throw, add your INT modifier to the roll.

trigger: You or a creature within 30 feet makes a check or save

summary.effect: You can attune to four magic items. Crafting a common or uncommon magic item takes a quarter of the normal time and half the gold.
After a long rest, store a 1st or 2nd level artificer spell in a weapon or spellcasting focus. A holder can cast it a number of times equal to twice your INT modifier before it empties.
You can attune to five magic items. You ignore class, race, spell and level requirements for attuning to or using a magic item.
You can attune to six magic items.
Add +1 to all saving throws per magic item you are attuned to. When reduced to 0 HP, end one infusion to drop to 1 HP instead.
Choose a specialty at 3rd level: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist or Battle Smith. It grants features at levels 3, 5, 9 and 15.
Gain proficiency with alchemists supplies. If you already have it, pick another artisan tool.

Always prepared, not counted against your limit: healing word, ray of sickness (3), flaming sphere, Melf's acid arrow (5), gaseous form, mass healing word (9), blight, death ward (13), cloudkill, raise dead (17).
After a long rest, create elixirs in empty flasks (one at 3rd level, two at 6th, three at 15th), each with a random effect. Spend a spell slot to make one more any time.
Using alchemists supplies as a focus, add your INT modifier (minimum +1) to one die of damage or healing from a spell you cast.
Elixirs also give temporary HP of 2d6 plus INT modifier. Cast lesser restoration without a slot a number of times per long rest equal to your INT modifier.
Resistance to acid and poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition. Once each per long rest, cast greater restoration or heal without a slot or components.
Gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.
Always prepared: magic missile, thunderwave (3), mirror image, shatter (5), hypnotic pattern, lightning bolt (9), fire shield, greater invisibility (13), passwall, wall of force (17).
Turn a suit of armor you wear into arcane armor. It has no STR requirement, acts as a spellcasting focus, cannot be removed against your will, and replaces missing limbs.
Choose Guardian or Infiltrator when you create it. Guardian: thunder gauntlets that taunt and a defensive field. Infiltrator: lightning launcher, +5 speed and stealth advantage.
Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.
Your armor counts as separate items for infusions: chest, boots, helmet and weapon. You gain two more infusion slots for it.
Guardian: pull a Large or smaller creature to you when it hits. Infiltrator: creatures hit by your launcher glow and are easier to hit.
Gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools. If you already have it, pick another artisan tool.
Always prepared: shield, thunderwave (3), scorching ray, shatter (5), fireball, wind wall (9), ice storm, wall of fire (13), cone of cold, wall of force (17).
Action: create a Small or Tiny cannon (flamethrower, force ballista or protector) that lasts one hour. Once per long rest free, or spend a spell slot for another.
Carve runes in a wand, staff or rod to make an arcane firearm. Add 1d8 damage to one damage roll of a spell cast through it.
Cannon damage rises by 1d8. As an action you can detonate it for a 3d8 force blast, destroying it.
You and allies within 10 feet of the cannon have half cover. You can have two cannons at once, activating both with one bonus action.
Gain proficiency with smith's tools. If you already have it, pick another artisan tool.
Always prepared: heroism, shield (3), branding smite, warding bond (5), aura of vitality, conjure barrage (9), aura of purity, fire shield (13), banishing smite, mass cure wounds (17).
Gain proficiency with martial weapons. Use INT instead of STR or DEX for attack and damage rolls with magic weapons.
After a long rest, build a steel defender companion. It obeys your commands and acts on your initiative. Its stats scale with your proficiency bonus and artificer level.
Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.
When you or your steel defender hit with a magic weapon attack, deal 2d6 extra force damage or heal a creature within 30 feet for 2d6. Uses equal your INT modifier.
Arcane Jolt grows to 4d6. Steel defender gains +2 AC and its Deflect Attack deals 1d4 plus your INT modifier force damage.
Artificer level 2+. A rod, staff or wand gains +1 to spell attack rolls (+2 at 10th level) and ignores half cover.
Artificer level 2+. Armor or a shield gains +1 AC (+2 at 10th level).
Artificer level 2+. A simple or martial weapon gains +1 to attack and damage (+2 at 10th level).
Artificer level 2+. Armor or robes let the wearer use a reaction to turn aside a failed concentration check.
Artificer level 2+. Create a tiny homunculus servant in an item of at least 100 gp that obeys you.
Artificer level 2+. Copy one item from the replicable list, such as bag of holding or alchemy jug.
Artificer level 6+. A shield gains +1 AC and lets the user push an attacker 15 feet with a reaction.
Artificer level 6+. Armor gives resistance to one damage type chosen at infusion.
Artificer level 2+. A thrown weapon gains +1 and flies back to the hand after a ranged attack.
Artificer level 2+. A ranged weapon gains +1 and makes its own ammunition.
Artificer level 6+. A weapon gains +1, sheds light, and can blind its attacker with a reaction.
Artificer level 14+. Armor gives 5-foot reach melee attacks from metal gauntlets and a speed boost.

name: Infusion: Boots of the Winding Path

summary.effect: Artificer level 6+. Boots let the wearer teleport 15 feet by bonus action.
Artificer level 6+. Armor stores a charge pool to boost STR checks and saves and prevent falling prone.
Artificer level 10+. A helmet grants advantage on initiative and prevents being surprised.
Artificer level 6+. A ring lets the wearer regain one spell slot of up to 3rd level once per day.
Gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or learn one language.
Advantage on saves to avoid falling off a mount. Land on your feet from a mount fall of under 10 feet. Mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

A melee hit marks the target until the end of your next turn. It has disadvantage against others. If it hurts someone else, attack it as a bonus action with advantage, adding half your fighter level in damage.

name: Warding Maneuver

summary.effect: Reaction when you or an ally within 5 feet is hit: add 1d8 to the AC against that hit. If the attack still hits, the damage is halved.

trigger: You or an ally within 5 ft is hit by an attack

summary.effect: Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move within your reach. A hit with that attack cuts the creature’s speed to 0 for the rest of the turn.
After moving at least 10 feet straight at a creature and hitting it, force a STR save (DC 8 + proficiency + STR) or it is knocked prone. Once per short or long rest.
On every creature’s turn (not just yours) you get a special reaction that can only be used for an opportunity attack.
Always prepared, not counted against your limit: disguise self (3), rope trick (5), fear (9), greater invisibility (13), seeming (17).
Add your WIS modifier to initiative. On the first turn of combat your speed rises by 10 feet and a weapon attack you make with the Attack action adds one extra attack that deals an extra 1d8.
Gain darkvision 60 feet, or add 30 feet to what you have. Creatures relying on darkvision cannot see you in darkness.
Gain proficiency in WIS saving throws. If you already have it, gain INT or CHA saves instead.
Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

name: Shadowy Dodge

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature attacks you without advantage: impose disadvantage on that attack roll.

trigger: A creature that does not have advantage makes an attack roll against you

name: Arcane Deflection

summary.effect: Reaction when you are hit or fail a save: gain +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save. Until the end of your next turn you can only cast cantrips.

trigger: You are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw

summary.effect: Add your INT modifier to initiative rolls.

Hold surges up to your INT modifier (minimum 1); a long rest resets you to one. Dispel magic or counterspell succeeding earns one. Once per turn, spend one for extra force damage of half your wizard level.
While concentrating on a spell, gain +2 AC and +2 to all saving throws.
When you use Arcane Deflection, up to three creatures you choose within 60 feet take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

Always prepared, not counted against your limit: faerie fire, sleep (1), moonbeam, see invisibility (3), aura of vitality, leomund’s tiny hut (5), aura of life, greater invisibility (7), circle of power, mislead (9).
Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
Gain darkvision 300 feet. As an action, share it for 1 hour with a number of creatures equal to your WIS modifier (minimum 1). Once per long rest, or by spending a spell slot.
As an action, touch a creature (not yourself) to give it advantage on its next initiative roll. The blessing ends when used or when you give it again.
A 30-foot sphere of twilight lasts 1 minute around you. A creature ending its turn there gains 1d6 + your cleric level temporary hit points, or you end one charm or fright effect on it.
In dim light or darkness, use a bonus action to gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Once per turn, a weapon hit deals extra 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 from level 14).
You and allies in your Twilight Sanctuary have half cover.
A pool of psionic dice, twice your proficiency bonus in number, regained on a long rest. The die is d6, then d8, d10 and d12 at levels 5, 11 and 17. Spend dice to power the features below.

name: Protective Field

summary.effect: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage: spend a die and reduce the damage by the roll plus your INT modifier.

trigger: You or another creature you can see within 30 ft takes damage

summary.effect: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, spend a die to add force damage equal to the roll plus your INT modifier.
Action: move a loose object or willing creature up to 30 feet within 30 feet of you. Once per short or long rest, or by spending a die.
Leap: bonus action, fly at twice your speed until turn end (once per rest, or spend a die). Thrust: Psionic Strike adds a STR save (DC 8 + proficiency + INT) or the target is prone or pushed 10 feet.
Resistance to psychic damage. At the start of your turn, spend a die to end a charm or fright effect on you.
Bonus action: up to your INT modifier creatures you choose within 30 feet (you included) gain half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest, or by spending a die.
Cast telekinesis using INT, once per long rest. While concentrating on it you can make a weapon attack as a bonus action.
+1 INT, WIS or CHA. Learn misty step and one 1st-level divination or enchantment spell. Cast each once per long rest for free, or with spell slots.
+1 INT, WIS or CHA. Learn invisibility and one 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell. Cast each once per long rest for free, or with spell slots.
+1 INT, WIS or CHA. Learn mage hand with an invisible hand and longer range. As a bonus action, target a creature within 30 feet: STR save or it moves 5 feet toward or away from you.
+1 INT, WIS or CHA. Speak mind to mind within 60 feet in a language you know. Cast detect thoughts once per long rest without a slot.
+1 STR or CON. Once per turn, a bludgeoning hit moves the target 5 feet. A critical hit gives all attackers advantage against it until the start of your next turn.
+1 STR or DEX. Once per turn, reroll one piercing damage die and keep the new roll. A critical hit adds one more damage die.
+1 STR or DEX. Once per turn, a slashing hit cuts the target’s speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. A critical hit gives it disadvantage on attacks until then.
+1 to any ability. Gain one skill proficiency and expertise in one skill you are already proficient in.
Needs elf or half-elf. +1 DEX, INT, WIS or CHA. When you have advantage on an attack with one of those abilities, reroll one of the dice once.
Needs dwarf. +1 CON. When you take the Dodge action, you can spend one Hit Die to heal as if on a short rest.
Needs gnome. +1 DEX or INT. Reaction after you take damage: become invisible until the end of your next turn, ending early if you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.
You know a reliable go-between who passes messages and rumours from the underworld. You can reach other criminals through them over long distances.
Venues put you up and feed you for free while you perform there. Locals tend to recognise you and treat you kindly.
Ordinary folk shelter and hide you if you are not in obvious danger, and will help you without sending you away. You find a place to rest among them.
Your guild gives you lodging, legal backing, and contacts. You pay dues, and fellow members may help you or open doors with local rulers.
Your time alone revealed a unique and powerful truth. Work out with your DM what it is and how it can change your story.
People assume you belong in high society and welcome you. Local nobles want to speak with you, and you can get an audience with a local figure.
Three loyal servants attend you: commoners who handle chores and errands. They will not fight for you and leave if you put them in danger.
You recall maps and the lay of the land well. You can find food and fresh water each day for yourself and up to five others.
When you do not know a piece of lore, you often know where to find it: a library, a scholar, or another source. The DM decides how hard it is to reach.
You can arrange free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and companions. You help crew the ship, and the captain decides how and when it sails.
Common folk fear you, so you get away with minor crimes in settled places. They will not report or confront you over them.
Soldiers of your former force still respect your rank. You can command lower-ranked soldiers and borrow simple gear or horses for short missions.
Your DM approves a feature from another background to fill this slot. Note it in your journal.
You know hidden routes through cities. Outside of combat, you and companions travel between two city spots at twice the normal speed.
Your walking speed is 35 feet, 5 more than most elves.
You can try to hide in light natural cover such as rain, fog, foliage or snow, even when only lightly obscured.
See in dim light within 120 feet as if bright, and in darkness as if dim. No colour in darkness.
In direct sunlight you have disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Perception checks, for you or your target in sunlight.
Know dancing lights. At 3rd level cast faerie fire and at 5th level darkness once each per long rest. Charisma is the casting ability.
Proficient with rapiers, shortswords and hand crossbows.
Proficient with light and medium armor.
Advantage on saves against poison, and resistance to poison damage.
Know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is the casting ability.
Through sounds and gestures you can pass simple ideas to Small or smaller beasts.
Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Add it in the sheet editor.
Take one feat of your choice at level 1, if your campaign allows feats. Add it in the sheet editor.
Gain a beast of CR 1/4 or lower as a companion. It acts on your initiative, uses your proficiency bonus, and has 4 HP per ranger level if that beats its own. Its stats are on Companions.
Bonus action: command your companion to Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help. Its attacks now count as magical.
Your companion makes two attacks when it takes the Attack action, or one attack plus a multiattack it already has.
When you cast a spell on yourself, it also affects your companion if it is within 30 feet.
